Task objective: Define one simple GET API: /v1/hello?name=Asmaa; expected 200 JSON response; choose local emulator and one Apigee non-prod environment for later integration.
Detailed actions: Write acceptance criteria and note the target org/environment; confirm permissions and Docker/Node/Java/Maven availability.
Tools: Cloud Code for VS Code; Apigee Emulator; Docker; Node.js; Java; Maven

Task objective: Create/open an Apigee workspace in VS Code and inspect the generated proxy folder structure.
Detailed actions: Confirm proxy bundle paths, proxy endpoint, target endpoint and resources folder; save a clean baseline.
Tools: Cloud Code for VS Code (Apigee workspace)

Task objective: Create a simple proxy that returns a predictable JSON response; use a mock target or a lightweight target endpoint.
Detailed actions: Set base path /v1/hello; configure request/response behavior; avoid adding complex policies that distract from CI/CD learning.

Task objective: Start/select a supported Apigee Emulator version and deploy the proxy to the emulator.
Detailed actions: Call the local endpoint with curl/Postman; verify status code, headers and JSON body; record emulator limitations.
Tools: Apigee Emulator; Docker; curl or Postman

Task objective: Add a simple input validation behavior, e.g. default name when omitted or reject an invalid value, and test it locally.
Detailed actions: Test happy path and at least one invalid/missing input; keep behavior deterministic.

Task objective: Create a Git repository and add proxy source, README, test collection, and ignore rules.
Detailed actions: Exclude local secrets, generated files and credentials; make the first commit with a meaningful message.
Tools: Git; GitHub (recommended) or Secure Source Manager

Task objective: Document local setup, how to run the emulator, endpoint behavior, and known limitations.
Detailed actions: Add a short README and sample request/response; note which config values vary by environment.

Task objective: Rebuild/redeploy from the workspace and confirm the repository contains everything needed to reproduce the proxy.
Detailed actions: Run the happy path and negative test again; commit the stable baseline and list blockers for Day 2.

Task objective: Add Node.js package configuration and install/pin apigeelint as a development dependency.
Detailed actions: Run apigeelint on the proxy bundle; save the baseline report and identify actionable findings.

Task objective: Fix the highest-value findings and distinguish true issues from justified exceptions.
Detailed actions: Re-run lint; document any suppression/exception with a reason rather than disabling checks broadly.

Task objective: Create a Postman collection with happy-path, missing/invalid input, status code and response-body assertions.
Detailed actions: Parameterize the base URL; avoid embedding credentials in collection files.

Task objective: Install Newman and run the collection against the local emulator.
Detailed actions: Export a machine-readable test report and ensure the command returns a failing exit code when assertions fail.

Pipeline step: Add JavaScript unit tests if applicable
Task objective: If the proxy contains JavaScript resources, add unit tests for the pure functions and edge cases; otherwise record this as not applicable.
Detailed actions: Do not invent JavaScript merely to create coverage. If JS exists, use Mocha/Chai (or Node test runner) and nyc.
Tools: Mocha + Chai + nyc, only for JS resources
Expected deliverable: Unit tests and coverage report, or N/A rationale

Task objective: Choose simple thresholds: lint must exit successfully; all functional tests must pass; JS coverage threshold applies only if JS resources exist.
Detailed actions: Make test failure stop the pipeline; document the thresholds in README.

Task objective: Set up the Apigee Deploy Maven Plugin v2.x for Apigee X/hybrid and package/import configuration according to its current README.
Detailed actions: Keep environment profiles separate from proxy source; use an access token from gcloud or an approved identity method, not a committed credential.
Tools: Maven; Apigee Deploy Maven Plugin v2.x

Task objective: Create non-production profile/config values and list required environment resources such as target servers or KVMs if the proxy uses them.
Detailed actions: Use placeholders for secrets; make configuration differences explicit; do not add unused resources just for the exercise.
Tools: Maven profiles/config; Secret Manager for secrets

Task objective: Confirm a safe Apigee non-production environment is available and identify the deployment identity and minimum required IAM roles.
Detailed actions: Verify org/environment names and API access before running deployment commands.
Tools: Apigee console; gcloud; Apigee Deploy Maven Plugin

Task objective: Deploy the packaged proxy to the non-production environment using the Maven plugin.
Detailed actions: Capture the deployed revision and deployment result; keep the command/profile repeatable.

Task objective: Run Newman against the deployed URL using a non-production Postman environment file.
Detailed actions: Confirm happy path and negative cases; fail the exercise if assertions do not pass.

Task objective: Temporarily introduce a controlled failing assertion or bad expected value and demonstrate that the test command fails.
Detailed actions: Restore the assertion immediately and rerun the suite to green; do not intentionally break a shared production service.
Expected deliverable: Evidence that failed tests are detectable

Task objective: Create a GitHub Actions workflow triggered on pull requests and pushes to the main branch.
Detailed actions: Pipeline steps: checkout, install pinned dependencies, run lint, run unit tests if applicable, run local/package checks, publish test output.
Tools: GitHub Actions or Cloud Build (choose one)

Task objective: Make lint and automated tests required steps; configure the workflow to stop when a command exits non-zero.
Detailed actions: Keep deployment out of untrusted pull-request jobs; separate validation from environment deployment.
Tools: GitHub Actions / Cloud Build; apigeelint; Newman

Task objective: Package the proxy bundle and retain the exact bundle plus version/commit metadata as a build artifact.
Detailed actions: For the POC, CI artifacts are sufficient; if using Artifact Registry, upload a versioned immutable artifact and verify it can be retrieved.
Expected deliverable: Traceable package tied to a commit

Task objective: Push a change and observe the workflow execute from source checkout through lint, tests and packaging.
Detailed actions: Fix path, dependency, permissions and test URL issues; capture a successful run.

Task objective: Configure deployment to a non-production environment only, triggered after CI succeeds and preferably after merge/approval.
Detailed actions: Store credentials in CI secrets or use workload identity federation where supported; never print tokens in logs.
Tools: GitHub Actions or Cloud Build; Maven plugin; IAM

Task objective: Add a Newman step after deployment, pointing to the deployed non-production URL.
Detailed actions: The pipeline must fail if post-deploy assertions fail; produce a readable report as an artifact.

Task objective: Create a simple dev ? test/stage ? prod promotion plan; for the POC, demonstrate only a safe lower-environment promotion if a second environment exists.
Detailed actions: Promote the same tested revision/artifact where possible; do not rebuild different source for production. Production approval is out of scope for the demo.
Tools: Maven promotion capability or apigeecli; environment profiles

Task objective: Review target server, KVM, environment-specific values, and secrets used by the proxy.
Detailed actions: Ensure no secrets in Git/history/artifacts; identify which resources are created manually vs automated as code.

Task objective: If time and a non-production endpoint are available, run a small baseline test and record latency/error rate.
Detailed actions: Set a conservative duration and rate; do not load test production or infer production capacity from a tiny test.
Expected deliverable: Optional baseline results or documented deferral

Task objective: Add API contract/OpenAPI file, test instructions, pipeline diagram/steps and release notes for the sample revision.
Detailed actions: Validate that another person can follow the README without undocumented setup steps.

Task objective: Make a small harmless change, open a PR, confirm CI gates, merge, deploy to non-production and run post-deploy tests.
Detailed actions: Confirm the tested commit, artifact, deployed revision and test report can be traced to one another.

Task objective: Demonstrate local development, lint failure/fix, automated tests, CI run, package, deployment and post-deploy verification.
Detailed actions: List what is complete, what is optional, and what needs hardening before production (IAM, approvals, artifact retention, rollback, monitoring).
Tools: All tools used in the POC
